paragraphs: A static, searchable catalog of Team Fortress 2 and Team Fortress 2 Classified Linux GameData signatures. The site supports name and signature search, library and architecture filters, signature copying, and English/Russian language selection. It loads the selected game's catalog from a generated JSON file and publishes from this repository through GitHub Pages.

Among 54,716 TF2 and Classified entries with the same name and library, 54,206 have the same x64 value and 510 differ. Do not assume a TF2 signature is interchangeable with Classified; select the target game and build explicitly.
